values.en: Continuous Maps Preserve Convergence in T2 Spaces
values.zh-CN: 连续映射保持 T2 空间中的收敛

content.snl:
thm-hyp(
    __list__(
        Type.annotation(@x_n, Type.to(Nat, X@Topology.ctxt.X)),
        Type.annotation(@x, X@Topology.ctxt.X),
        Type.annotation(@f, Type.to(X@Topology.ctxt.X, Y@Topology.ctxt.Y))
    ),
    Logic.implies(
        Logic.and(Topology.T2(X@Topology.ctxt.X), Topology.continuous(f, x)),
        Logic.implies(Topology.seqConvergence(x_n, x), Topology.seqConvergence(Type.apply(f, x_n), Type.apply(f, x)))
    )
)
